name: Darkon
title: Descendant of Solomon's Servants
summary: Darkon was the ancestor of a family among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from exile in Babylon to Jerusalem. He is mentioned in the records of those who returned with Zerubbabel, and his family were among the temple servants who rebuilt the Jewish community after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Descendants of Solomon's Servants in Ezra
keyEvents.description: Darkon's descendants are listed among the children of Solomon's servants who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Returnees in Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Darkon's family is mentioned again in Nehemiah's parallel list of those who returned from the Babylonian captivity.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Darkon and his descendants were part of the large group that returned to Judah under Zerubbabel's leadership to rebuild the temple and the community.

keyEvents.title: Service in the Temple
keyEvents.description: As descendants of Solomon's servants, Darkon's family had a special role connected to service in the temple, a tradition dating back to King Solomon's time.
